name: AI
title: Agentic Coding Assistants
headline: Code Property Graph (CPG) RAG Engine
summary: A high-performance, local-first AI coding framework leveraging CPG to enable complex static analysis. Designed to analyse architectural patterns, generate test cases, and flag potential security weaknesses.

rationale.title: Expert Agents
rationale.description: A team of agents specialising in security, architecture and testing to provide deep, domain-specific code insights.

rationale.title: Structured Evidence Extraction
rationale.description: Pydantic validation ensures high-integrity data structures that improve LLM comprehension.

rationale.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
rationale.description: Neo4j Cypher query templates are wrapped as Tools for agents to access via a unified FastAPI MCP service.

videos.title: Architectural Auditing
videos.desc: Detecting circular dependencies and 'spaghetti' patterns via the Architect.

videos.title: Automated Test Generation
videos.desc: TestEngineer generating test cases based on graph-discovered paths.

videos.title: Security Taint Analysis
videos.desc: Watching the SecurityResearcher identify a security weakness and enrich it with CWE data.

name: Streaming
title: Web Browser Observability
headline: Event Streaming & Real-time Analytics
summary: A high-velocity stream processing engine for real-time web browsing analytics. Transforms raw Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) events into immediate visual insights using a distributed message bus and stateful stream processing.

rationale.title: Stateful Fault Tolerance
rationale.description: Checkpoints persist streaming state to MinIO (S3-compatible). This allows the pipeline to recover rapidly from node failures.

rationale.title: Lightweight Message Bus
rationale.description: Redpanda (Kafka-compatible) chosen for its zero-JVM, C++ architecture.

rationale.title: Real-time Feature Enrichment
rationale.description: Redis acts as a real-time, in-memory lookup to enrich data streams with sub-millisecond latency.

videos.title: Spark Windowing
videos.desc: Deep-dive into the temporal aggregation logic.

name: Lakehouse
title: Football Data Lakehouse
headline: Medallion Architecture & Data Modelling
summary: A high-integrity analytical platform designed to integrate multi-source data into a unified Master Data model. The system leverages a decoupled storage-compute architecture with Iceberg, Spark and Trino to perform high-performance batch ELT.

rationale.title: Storage Layer
rationale.description: Apache Iceberg and Parquet provide a reliable lakehouse foundation for high-speed analytical queries.

rationale.title: Orchestration
rationale.description: Airflow DAGs manage complex ELT and maintenance workflows, ensuring data integrity across the entire data lifecycle.

rationale.title: Scalability
rationale.description: Decoupled storage (MinIO) from compute (Spark & Trino) to allow independent scaling of infrastructure.

videos.title: Medallion Architecture & Data Model
videos.desc: Walking through Bronze to Gold transformation logic.

videos.title: Performance Optimisation
videos.desc: Comparing different storage layouts and query patterns.

name: MLOps
title: Football MLOps
headline: ML Lifecycle Management
summary: A specialized MLOps platform designed to accelerate the journey from notebook-based experimentation to production-grade deployments. It enforces operational stability by automatically wrapping each deployed model in a standardised layer of governance, observability, and drift monitoring.

rationale.title: Experiment Tracking
rationale.description: MLflow integration ensures every hyperparameter tweak and dataset version is logged for auditability.

rationale.title: Environment Parity
rationale.description: Containerised Jupyter environments ensure consistent library versions across development and production.

rationale.title: Model Governance
rationale.description: MLflow and MinIO provide a robust governance framework by combining logical lifecycle tracking with immutable physical storage.

videos.title: MLflow Dashboard
videos.desc: Comparing model runs and loss curves.

name: CI/CD
title: Modern CI/CD Pipeline
headline: Automated QA and Deployment
summary: A professional-grade CI/CD workflow for a GitHub repository. Automates the entire lifecycle from linting and testing to performance auditing and deployment.

rationale.title: Testing Strategy
rationale.description: Implemented Vitest for lightning-fast unit and component testing within the Vite ecosystem.

rationale.title: Developer Experience
rationale.description: Strict ESLint and Prettier configurations enforced at the pre-commit and CI stages.

rationale.title: Automated Audits
rationale.description: GitHub Actions trigger Lighthouse CI to prevent performance regressions in pull requests.
